arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍۢ وَاقِعٍۢ

translations.en.sahih: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
translations.en.pickthall: A questioner questioned concerning the doom about to fall
translations.en.yusufali: A questioner asked about a Penalty to befall-
translations.id.indonesian: Seseorang telah meminta kedatangan azab yang akan menimpa,

translations.en.sahih: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
translations.en.pickthall: Upon the disbelievers, which none can repel,
translations.en.yusufali: The Unbelievers, the which there is none to ward off,-
translations.id.indonesian: orang-orang kafir, yang tidak seorangpun dapat menolaknya,

translations.en.sahih: [It is] from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent.
translations.en.pickthall: From Allah, Lord of the Ascending Stairways
translations.en.yusufali: (A Penalty) from Allah, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.
translations.id.indonesian: (yang datang) dari Allah, Yang mempunyai tempat-tempat naik.

arabic: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ
transliteration: Ta'rujul malaaa'ikatu war Roohu ilaihi fee yawmin kaana miqdaaruhoo khamseena alfa sanah

translations.en.sahih: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
translations.en.pickthall: (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years.
translations.en.yusufali: The angels and the spirit ascend unto him in a Day the measure whereof is (as) fifty thousand years:
translations.id.indonesian: Malaikat-malaikat dan Jibril naik (menghadap) kepada Tuhan dalam sehari yang kadarnya limapuluh ribu tahun.

translations.en.sahih: So be patient with gracious patience.
translations.en.pickthall: But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see.
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore do thou hold Patience,- a Patience of beautiful (contentment).
translations.id.indonesian: Maka bersabarlah kamu dengan sabar yang baik.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! they behold it afar off
translations.en.yusufali: They see the (Day) indeed as a far-off (event):
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya mereka memandang siksaaan itu jauh (mustahil).

translations.en.sahih: But We see it [as] near.
translations.en.pickthall: While we behold it nigh:
translations.en.yusufali: But We see it (quite) near.
translations.id.indonesian: Sedangkan Kami memandangnya dekat (mungkin terjadi).

translations.en.sahih: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
translations.en.pickthall: The day when the sky will become as molten copper,
translations.en.yusufali: The Day that the sky will be like molten brass,
translations.id.indonesian: Pada hari ketika langit menjadi seperti luluhan perak,

translations.en.sahih: And the mountains will be like wool,
translations.en.pickthall: And the hills become as flakes of wool,
translations.en.yusufali: And the mountains will be like wool,
translations.id.indonesian: dan gunung-gunung menjadi seperti bulu (yang berterbangan),

translations.en.sahih: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
translations.en.pickthall: And no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend
translations.en.yusufali: And no friend will ask after a friend,
translations.id.indonesian: dan tidak ada seorang teman akrabpun menanyakan temannya,

arabic: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
transliteration: Yubassaroonahum; ya waddul mujrimu law yaftadee min 'azaabi yawma'izim bibaneeh

translations.en.sahih: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
translations.en.pickthall: Though they will be given sight of them. The guilty man will long to be able to ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children
translations.en.yusufali: Though they will be put in sight of each other,- the sinner's desire will be: Would that he could redeem himself from the Penalty of that Day by (sacrificing) his children,
translations.id.indonesian: sedang mereka saling memandang. Orang kafir ingin kalau sekiranya dia dapat menebus (dirinya) dari azab hari itu dengan anak-anaknya,

translations.en.sahih: And his wife and his brother
translations.en.pickthall: And his spouse and his brother
translations.en.yusufali: His wife and his brother,
translations.id.indonesian: dan isterinya dan saudaranya,

translations.en.sahih: And his nearest kindred who shelter him
translations.en.pickthall: And his kin that harboured him
translations.en.yusufali: His kindred who sheltered him,
translations.id.indonesian: dan kaum familinya yang melindunginya (di dunia).

arabic: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
transliteration: Wa man fil ardi jamee'an summa yunjeeh

translations.en.sahih: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
translations.en.pickthall: And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him.
translations.en.yusufali: And all, all that is on earth,- so it could deliver him:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan orang-orang di atas bumi seluruhnya kemudian (mengharapkan) tebusan itu dapat menyelamatkannya.

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
translations.en.pickthall: But nay! for lo! it is the fire of hell
translations.en.yusufali: By no means! for it would be the Fire of Hell!-
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali tidak dapat, sesungguhnya neraka itu adalah api yang bergolak,

translations.en.sahih: A remover of exteriors.
translations.en.pickthall: Eager to roast;
translations.en.yusufali: Plucking out (his being) right to the skull!-
translations.id.indonesian: yang mengelupas kulit kepala,

translations.en.sahih: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
translations.en.pickthall: It calleth him who turned and fled (from truth),
translations.en.yusufali: Inviting (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from the Right).
translations.id.indonesian: yang memanggil orang yang membelakang dan yang berpaling (dari agama),

translations.en.sahih: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.
translations.en.pickthall: And hoarded (wealth) and withheld it.
translations.en.yusufali: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from use)!
translations.id.indonesian: serta mengumpulkan (harta benda) lalu menyimpannya.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! man was created anxious,
translations.en.yusufali: Truly man was created very impatient;-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya manusia diciptakan bersifat keluh kesah lagi kikir.

translations.en.sahih: When evil touches him, impatient,
translations.en.pickthall: Fretful when evil befalleth him
translations.en.yusufali: Fretful when evil touches him;
translations.id.indonesian: Apabila ia ditimpa kesusahan ia berkeluh kesah,

translations.en.sahih: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],
translations.en.pickthall: And, when good befalleth him, grudging;
translations.en.yusufali: And niggardly when good reaches him;-
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila ia mendapat kebaikan ia amat kikir,

translations.en.sahih: Except the observers of prayer -
translations.en.pickthall: Save worshippers.
translations.en.yusufali: Not so those devoted to Prayer;-
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali orang-orang yang mengerjakan shalat,

translations.en.sahih: Those who are constant in their prayer
translations.en.pickthall: Who are constant at their worship
translations.en.yusufali: Those who remain steadfast to their prayer;
translations.id.indonesian: yang mereka itu tetap mengerjakan shalatnya,

translations.en.sahih: And those within whose wealth is a known right
translations.en.pickthall: And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged
translations.en.yusufali: And those in whose wealth is a recognised right.
translations.id.indonesian: dan orang-orang yang dalam hartanya tersedia bagian tertentu,

translations.en.sahih: For the petitioner and the deprived -
translations.en.pickthall: For the beggar and the destitute;
translations.en.yusufali: For the (needy) who asks and him who is prevented (for some reason from asking);
translations.id.indonesian: bagi orang (miskin) yang meminta dan orang yang tidak mempunyai apa-apa (yang tidak mau meminta),

translations.en.sahih: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
translations.en.pickthall: And those who believe in the Day of Judgment,
translations.en.yusufali: And those who hold to the truth of the Day of Judgment;
translations.id.indonesian: dan orang-orang yang mempercayai hari pembalasan,

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
translations.en.pickthall: And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom -
translations.en.yusufali: And those who fear the displeasure of their Lord,-
translations.id.indonesian: dan orang-orang yang takut terhadap azab Tuhannya.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure -
translations.en.yusufali: For their Lord's displeasure is the opposite of Peace and Tranquillity;-
translations.id.indonesian: Karena sesungguhnya azab Tuhan mereka tidak dapat orang merasa aman (dari kedatangannya).

translations.en.sahih: And those who guard their private parts
translations.en.pickthall: And those who preserve their chastity
translations.en.yusufali: And those who guard their chastity,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan orang-orang yang memelihara kemaluannya,

arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
transliteration: Illaa 'alaaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aymaanuhum fainnahum ghairu maloomeen

translations.en.sahih: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
translations.en.pickthall: Save with their wives and those whom their right hands possess, for thus they are not blameworthy;
translations.en.yusufali: Except with their wives and the (captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (then) they are not to be blamed,
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali terhadap isteri-isteri mereka atau budak-budak yang mereka miliki, maka sesungguhnya mereka dalam hal ini tiada tercela.

arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
transliteration: Famanib taghaa waraaa'a zaalika fa ulaaa'ika humul 'aadoon

translations.en.sahih: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
translations.en.pickthall: But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors;
translations.en.yusufali: But those who trespass beyond this are transgressors;-
translations.id.indonesian: Barangsiapa mencari yang di balik itu, maka mereka itulah orang-orang yang melampaui batas.

transliteration: Wallazeena hum li amaa naatihim wa 'ahdihim raa'oon

translations.en.sahih: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
translations.en.pickthall: And those who keep their pledges and their covenant,
translations.en.yusufali: And those who respect their trusts and covenants;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan orang-orang yang memelihara amanat-amanat (yang dipikulnya) dan janjinya.

translations.en.sahih: And those who are in their testimonies upright
translations.en.pickthall: And those who stand by their testimony
translations.en.yusufali: And those who stand firm in their testimonies;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan orang-orang yang memberikan kesaksiannya.

translations.en.sahih: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
translations.en.pickthall: And those who are attentive at their worship.
translations.en.yusufali: And those who guard (the sacredness) of their worship;-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan orang-orang yang memelihara shalatnya.

translations.en.sahih: They will be in gardens, honored.
translations.en.pickthall: These will dwell in Gardens, honoured.
translations.en.yusufali: Such will be the honoured ones in the Gardens (of Bliss).
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka itu (kekal) di surga lagi dimuliakan.

transliteration: Famaa lil lazeena kafaroo qibalaka muhti'een

translations.en.sahih: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad],
translations.en.pickthall: What aileth those who disbelieve, that they keep staring toward thee (O Muhammad), open-eyed,
translations.en.yusufali: Now what is the matter with the Unbelievers that they rush madly before thee-
translations.id.indonesian: Mengapakah orang-orang kafir itu bersegera datang ke arahmu,

translations.en.sahih: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?
translations.en.pickthall: On the right and on the left, in groups?
translations.en.yusufali: From the right and from the left, in crowds?
translations.id.indonesian: dari kanan dan dari kiri dengan berkelompok-kelompok.

arabic: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ
transliteration: Ayatma'u kullum ri'im minhum anyyudkhala jannata Na'eem

translations.en.sahih: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
translations.en.pickthall: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?
translations.en.yusufali: Does every man of them long to enter the Garden of Bliss?
translations.id.indonesian: Adakah setiap orang dari orang-orang kafir itu ingin masuk ke dalam surga yang penuh kenikmatan?,

transliteration: Kallaaa innaa khalaq nahum mimmaa ya'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know.
translations.en.yusufali: By no means! For We have created them out of the (base matter) they know!
translations.id.indonesian: sekali-kali tidak! Sesungguhnya Kami ciptakan mereka dari apa yang mereka ketahui (air mani).

arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
transliteration: Falaaa uqsimu bi Rabbil mashaariqi wal maghaaribi innaa laqaadiroon

translations.en.sahih: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
translations.en.pickthall: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the planets that We verily are Able
translations.en.yusufali: Now I do call to witness the Lord of all points in the East and the West that We can certainly-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka aku bersumpah dengan Tuhan Yang memiliki timur dan barat, sesungguhnya Kami benar-benar Maha Kuasa.

arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
transliteration: 'Alaaa an nubaddila khairam minhum wa maa Nahnu bimasbooqeen

translations.en.sahih: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
translations.en.pickthall: To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun.
translations.en.yusufali: Substitute for them better (men) than they; And We are not to be defeated (in Our Plan).
translations.id.indonesian: Untuk mengganti (mereka) dengan kaum yang lebih baik dari mereka, dan Kami sekali-kali tidak dapat dikalahkan.

arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
transliteration: Fazarhum yakhoodoo wa yal'aboo hattaa yulaaqoo yaw mahumul lazee yoo'adoon

translations.en.sahih: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
translations.en.pickthall: So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised,
translations.en.yusufali: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they encounter that Day of theirs which they have been promised!-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka biarkanlah mereka tenggelam (dalam kebatilan) dan bermain-main sampai mereka menjumpai hari yang diancamkan kepada mereka,

arabic: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًۭا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍۢ يُوفِضُونَ
transliteration: Yawma yakhrujoona minal ajdaasi siraa'an ka anna hum ilaa nusubiny yoofidoon

translations.en.sahih: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
translations.en.pickthall: The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal,
translations.en.yusufali: The Day whereon they will issue from their sepulchres in sudden haste as if they were rushing to a goal-post (fixed for them),-
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) pada hari mereka keluar dari kubur dengan cepat seakan-akan mereka pergi dengan segera kepada berhala-berhala (sewaktu di dunia),

arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
transliteration: Khaashi'atan absaaruhum tarhaquhum zillah; zaalikal yawmul lazee kaanoo yoo'adoon

translations.en.sahih: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
translations.en.pickthall: With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they are promised.
translations.en.yusufali: Their eyes lowered in dejection,- ignominy covering them (all over)! such is the Day the which they are promised!
translations.id.indonesian: dalam keadaan mereka menekurkan pandangannya (serta) diliputi kehinaan. Itulah hari yang dahulunya diancamkan kepada mereka.
